briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies AGI race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs race toward AGI with o4, Claude 4, and Gemini 3 deployments. Funding surges past $11B this quarter while regulatory scrutiny grows. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 4.2T parameters and native tool use. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 3.1 follow closely. DeepSeek-V3 achieves 92% MMLU at lower inference cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New jailbreak vectors reported against multimodal models. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell B200 clusters to xAI and Microsoft. TSMC reports 3nm yield gains for custom ASICs. Saudi Arabia announces $40B AI data center buildout.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems achieve coherent long-term planning before 2028?
